name: structure
description: Structural-element (SEL) visualization, one item type per element: structure-beam / structure-cable / structure-pile (line elements, carry the 'line' keyword) and structure-geogrid / structure-liner / structure-shell (surface elements, carry 'polygons'). 'contour <attribute>' maps forces/moments/resultants; 'label <type>' colours by group/model/state. 'structure-vector' draws nodal vectors.

sub_items.name: contour
sub_items.description: Contour attributes for line elements (force/moment) and shells (resultants/stress).

sub_items.name: label
sub_items.description: Categorical colour SELs by group, model, id, type-element, plastic state, ...

notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against 3DEC 9.0.
Line elements (beam/cable/pile) accept 'line'; surface elements (geogrid/liner/shell) accept 'polygons' — otherwise the top-level keyword set is identical.
structure-shell adds resultants-* and stress-elastic/plastic-* and coupling-* contour attributes that line elements do not have.

structure-beam / -cable / -pile / -hybrid top-level keywords: Bar, BarScale, FlipBars, active, clip, color-list, contour, cut, deformation-factor, label, legend, line, map, marker, range, shrink, slot, system, transparency
structure-geogrid / -liner / -shell top-level keywords: active, clip, color-list, contour, cut, deformation-factor, label, legend, map, marker, polygons, range, shrink, slot, system, transparency

structure-dowel top-level keywords: active, clip, color-list, contour, cut, deformation-factor, doweloffset, label, legend, length-scale, map, marker, minval, offsetnormal, range, shrink, slot, system, transparency, usesminval, width-scale
structure-vector top-level keywords: active, by-magnitude, clip, color, cut, deformation-factor, draw-as, legend, map, point-to-base, quality, range, scale, shape, structures, transparency, value

Live 9.7 splits the family: 1D elements (beam/cable/pile/hybrid) draw as lines and carry the leaked-internal CamelCase keywords Bar/BarScale/FlipBars (really accepted - same quirk as FLAC3D); surface elements (geogrid/liner/shell) use polygons instead of line; structure-dowel has its own 21-keyword set (doweloffset/length-scale/minval/offsetnormal/usesminval/width-scale - matches the FLAC3D finding that the dowel analogy to beams is wrong); structure-vector is a vector item (by-magnitude/color/draw-as/point-to-base/quality/scale/shape/structures/value), NOT a styled element view - Verified against live 3DEC 9.7.47 ('?' enumeration), 2026-08-14.
